_comment: Removed a fabricated BANISH_FROM_GRAVEYARD additional cost. The card says 'You may PLAY Mutated Mass FROM YOUR BANISHED ZONE' -- a play-from-zone permission, not a cost. Modelled as a cost it made the card UNPLAYABLE whenever the graveyard was empty, and banished a card from it when it was not. A wrong cost is worse than a wrong effect: it blocks legality.
